name: greeter
title: The Silent Greeting of Blokur
tagline: A friendly ghost from the DAO Fork era remains untouched and uncalled.

chapters.heading: The greeter's first breath
paragraphs: A soft light flickers on the grave of the greeter. It arrived on September 7, 2016, during the DAO Fork era. A wallet ending in 2d5e brought it into the world. The contract is a small program that lives on Ethereum.

It was written in Solidity 0.3.6 to say Hello from Blokur! On the day it was born, it was written into a block, one page of Ethereum's shared record book. Now it sits ten years old and still waits in the quiet.

chapters.heading: The greeter's long silence
paragraphs: The greeter arrived on September 7, 2016. It waited in the quiet for 10.1 years. No one ever called it.
The code still sits on the chain. It holds 0.0 ETH inside its hollow heart.
